subject.title: fix(ui): hide the custodian from the agent switcher

question: Should the gateway/control-UI owner approve the intended boundary that reserved custodian IDs are hidden only when discovered from disk, while explicitly configured entries remain visible for diagnosis?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and appears consistent with the PR’s stated diagnostic exception, but that exception defines the user-visible product boundary for reserved system agents and the PR is protected by the `maintainer` label.

options.title: Approve the scoped discovery filter
options.body: Accept the current behavior: hide reserved IDs from ordinary disk discovery while leaving explicit configuration visible for diagnosis.

options.title: Change the diagnostic contract first
options.body: Specify a different treatment for explicitly configured reserved IDs, then update the implementation and regression coverage to that approved contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped discovery filter
recommendation.body: Accept the current behavior: hide reserved IDs from ordinary disk discovery while leaving explicit configuration visible for diagnosis.
